description: Erection of a two storey side extension for use as an annex.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan, 0150/82OCTA-01, 0150/82OCTA-03  received 7 May 2021; 0150/82OCTA-02 received 3 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The two-storey side extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 82 Octavia Road TW7 6JP.
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the first floor of the side (south) elevation shall be obscure glazed, non opening  and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
